# Heading

### Decisions

- **Level context.** `useSectionLevel`, `useHeadingLevel` and the `HeadingLevelProvider` are shared per-system behaviors: a Section publishes the enclosing level plus one (or its `level` override), clamped at six, and a Heading reads it. A Section's `level` sets the subtree's level outright - `level: 3` headings three - not a skip count.
- **Type set.** A level N heading draws `type.heading0<7 - N>`: heading-06 at level 1 down to heading-01 at level 6, and `color.text_primary`. The type name is the theme's flat family; where the theme aliases two of the family's sets to the same values, the two levels look alike, same as the reference's own sets.
- **Semantics.** `accessibilityRole: 'header'` plus the level ride the registry Text; the host turns them into the heading element of that level, so a screen reader announcement and the document outline see real headings on every level.
- **Deep reads.** A hosted overlay keeps the heading context it opened from (the overlay bridge republishes it), so a Heading inside a Modal keeps its section depth.

### Platform

Section is a plain container on every platform; the heading element is the web host's answer to the header role and the level.

## Heading

Heading draws a heading in the theme's type set for its level, one level deeper inside each Section.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | no | The heading text. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the heading. |

### Metrics

None: every value this component draws is a token named in its props or listed under `tokens`.

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| level 1 | `{"children":"Level one"}` |
| level 2 | `{"children":"Level two"}` |
| level 3 | `{"children":"Level three"}` |
| level 6 | `{"children":"Level six"}` |
| level 7 | `{"children":"Level seven"}` |

`level 2` mounts inside Section wrapper (sample composition, not a prop).

`level 3` mounts inside Section > Section wrappers (sample composition, not a prop).

`level 6` mounts inside Section > Section > Section > Section > Section wrappers (sample composition, not a prop).

`level 7` mounts inside Section > Section > Section > Section > Section > Section > Section wrappers (sample composition, not a prop).

## Section

Section raises the heading level of every Heading inside it by one, up to six.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | `number` | no | Heading level override for the subtree: an integer 1 through 6. Omitted, the section raises the enclosing level by one, clamped at 6. |
| `children` | `node` | no | Content under the deeper heading level. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

None: every value this component draws is a token named in its props or listed under `tokens`.

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"Section content"}` |
